# hestiacp_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone in HestiaCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String)

### Optional

- `ip` (String) Default IP for zone SOA record.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username that owns this zone. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
